scenarios.name: Happy Path
scenarios.description: Customer calls, speaks English, asks if they can complete their 2030 CQA over the phone. Has their census ID and authenticates and completes 2030 CQA over the phone.

scenarios.name: Alternate Path 1
scenarios.description: Customer calls, speaks English, asks several questions that do not require authentication. IVR collects intents (FAQs), retrieves knowledge, answers each question asking inbetween if the customer is satisfied.

scenarios.name: Alternate Path 2
scenarios.description: Customer calls, speaks English, asks if they can complete their 2030 CQA over the phone. Has their census ID and authenticates, only gets through a part of the 2030 CQA, routes to a live agent who gets context of call and picks up where the IVR left off, completes 2030 CQA with live agent assistance.

scenarios.name: Alternate Path 3
scenarios.description: Customer calls, speaks Spanish, asks if they can complete their 2030 CQA over the phone. Does not have their census ID, but IVR collects intent (enumeration) and passes to a live agent after 3 failed attempts to authenticate. Live agent gets context of call including customer intent and point at which customer got stuck, picks up where the IVR left off.

scenarios.name: Alternate Path 4
scenarios.description: Customer calls, speaks French, IVR detects French, IVR asks for call reason, customer provides, IVR translates and passes to a French speaking live agent the customer’s intent.
